paragraphs.text: Xerex is a plane that features enormous underground passages with Escherian reality - or physics-bending effects - and kaleidoscopic geometric features.

Next-to-nothing is known about Xerex before the New Phyrexian Invasion ; most factions of Phyrexia — save the Etched Host — made an incursion onto the plane. The result was a failure not by any form of concerted defense, but because the nebulous reality in Xerex was too alien for the literalist Phyrexians to comprehend.
